request: Order ORD-1001 hasn't shipped yet. Investigate why and what we should do.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to confirm status, warehouse, line items, and promised date so I can decide whether to check inventory or shipments.
I will check inventory for SKU-202 at WH-BOS to see if stock is sufficient to fulfill the pending order.
I will search other warehouses for 38 units of SKU-202 to see if a single site can cover the shortfall for a transfer.

arguments.recommendation: Request an immediate inter-warehouse transfer of 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS and expedite the move to protect the 2026-03-19 promised delivery date.
